story: Abhimanyu, son of Arjuna and Subhadra, heard how to break into the chakravyuha, a spiral battle formation, while still in his mother's womb. But Subhadra fell asleep before he heard how to get out. On the 13th day of the war he broke in alone and was trapped and killed by several warriors at once.
belief: He is remembered as the bravest young hero of the Mahabharata, and his death as one of its great injustices. His name is used for anyone fighting alone against impossible odds.
turns: He entered the formation knowing he could not get out. His courage ran ahead of his preparation.
facts: He was only about 16 when he died.
His son Parikshit became king after the war and carried on the dynasty.
He was married to Uttara, princess of Virata.
lessons: Courage needs a way out as well as a way in.
Learn the whole lesson, not half of it.
Bravery is honoured even in defeat.
more: His mother Subhadra was Krishna's sister.
Jayadratha held the other Pandavas back at the formation's entrance; Arjuna killed Jayadratha the next day.
